items.title: Back to Hamburg
items.summary: Returning to a race that has always meant something, with the standard higher than ever.
items.take: We know the standard will be up there with the best. We'll fight until the last wall ball.

items.title: Training with your cycle, not beneath it
items.summary: Tracking gives context. It doesn't automatically decide what an athlete can do that day.
items.take: Use the information, assess how you feel, then make the right training decision for you.

items.title: Conditions won't always be perfect
items.summary: Wrong shoes, dead headphones, hard session. The work can still get done.
items.take: Performance isn't about waiting for the perfect environment. It's about executing anyway.
